commands.clean_cache: sudo apt-get clean && sudo apt-get autoremove -y

commands.allow_source_port: sudo ufw allow from {source_ip} to any port {port} proto {proto}

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Automatic service start on package installation
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Debian/Ubuntu automatically starts daemons upon apt-get install.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: If configuration is required before starting, prepare config files in advance or handle the initial failed start.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not assume installed services are stopped.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: PEP 668 externally-managed Python environment
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Debian 12+ and Ubuntu 23.04+ disable direct pip install into system Python.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Use python3 -m venv <dir> or apt-get install python3-<pkg>.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not use --break-system-packages unless strictly isolated in a container.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Deb822 structured format in Ubuntu 24.04+
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Ubuntu 24.04 stores repository entries in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources rather than classic one-line format.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Check for .sources files when inspecting or managing repositories.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not append classic one-line deb entries directly into /etc/apt/sources.list on 24.04+ without checking.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (Could not get lock /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend|Resource temporarily unavailable.*dpkg|Unable to acquire the dpkg frontend lock)
common_error_signatures.explanation: Another package management process (such as unattended-upgrades) is actively locking the dpkg frontend database.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (dpkg was interrupted, you must manually run 'dpkg --configure -a'|Sub-process /usr/bin/dpkg returned an error code)
common_error_signatures.explanation: A prior package transaction was terminated abruptly before completing configuration hooks.

common_error_signatures.pattern: Hash Sum mismatch|Hashes of expected file do not match
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && sudo apt-get clean && sudo apt-get update
common_error_signatures.explanation: Locally cached repository metadata or package archives became desynchronized with upstream mirrors.

common_error_signatures.pattern: NO_PUBKEY\s+([A-F0-9]+)
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo gpg --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys {match_1} && sudo gpg --export --armor {match_1} | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/{match_1}.asc >/dev/null && sudo apt-get update
common_error_signatures.explanation: A third-party APT repository is missing the corresponding GPG public signature verification key.

common_error_signatures.pattern: Release file for .* is not valid yet \(invalid for another.*\)|Release file .* is expired
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo timedatectl set-ntp true && sudo apt-get update
common_error_signatures.explanation: System clock skew caused APT to reject valid upstream Release files as expired or premature.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (You have held broken packages|Unmet dependencies\. Try 'apt --fix-broken install'|Depends: .* but it is not going to be installed)
common_error_signatures.explanation: Package dependency solver encountered mutually exclusive package versions or held broken packages.

common_error_signatures.pattern: apparmor="DENIED" operation="([^"]+)" profile="([^"]+)" name="([^"]+)"
common_error_signatures.explanation: AppArmor Mandatory Access Control profile denied access to the confined resource.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (netplan.*Invalid YAML|yaml-cpp.*error.*netplan|Error in network definition)
common_error_signatures.explanation: YAML indentation or syntax error in /etc/netplan/*.yaml prevented network configuration generation.

commands.allow_source_port: sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule='rule family="ipv4" source address="{source_ip}" port port="{port}" protocol="{proto}" accept' && sudo firewall-cmd --reload

commands.generate_allow_module: sudo ausearch -m avc -ts recent | audit2allow -M {module_name} && sudo semodule -i {module_name}.pp

commands.check_lvm: sudo lvs && sudo pvs && sudo vgs

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Services are not automatically started upon package installation
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Unlike Debian/Ubuntu, installing a package on RHEL does not start or enable the systemd service.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not assume the service is running after dnf install.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: SELinux context preservation on mv vs cp
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Moving files preserves the original context, while copying inherits the destination context.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Always run sudo restorecon -Rv <path> when moving config or web root files.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not disable SELinux permanently when a context mismatch occurs.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Firewalld rules require --permanent and --reload
quirks_and_gotchas.description: firewall-cmd rules without --permanent are volatile and lost upon service restart or reboot.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not omit --permanent unless testing temporary rules intentionally.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (cannot open Packages database in /var/lib/rpm|rpmdb: BDB\d+|error: rpmdb: damaged header)
common_error_signatures.explanation: The Berkeley DB RPM database is stale or corrupted.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (SELinux is preventing .* from (read|write|open|execute|connect|getattr)|type=AVC msg=audit.*denied)
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo ausearch -m avc -ts recent | audit2why; sudo restorecon -Rv {path}
common_error_signatures.explanation: SELinux MAC security context denied access to the file, port, or socket.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (Waiting for process with pid \d+|Another app is currently holding the dnf lock)
common_error_signatures.explanation: PackageKit or another DNF process is currently holding the transaction lock.

common_error_signatures.pattern: Modular dependency problem.*problem with installed package
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo dnf module reset -y {module} && sudo dnf distro-sync -y
common_error_signatures.explanation: A conflicting DNF module stream version is enabled.

common_error_signatures.pattern: FirewallD is not running
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo systemctl enable --now firewalld && sudo firewall-cmd --state
common_error_signatures.explanation: The firewalld service is stopped or disabled.

commands.open_port: sudo nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport {port} accept
commands.close_port: sudo nft delete rule inet filter input handle {handle}
commands.deny_port: sudo nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport {port} drop
commands.allow_source_port: sudo nft add rule inet filter input ip saddr {source_ip} tcp dport {port} accept

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Partial upgrades break Arch rolling release systems
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Running pacman -Sy <pkg> without updating the entire system causes shared library ABI mismatches.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Configuration files are saved as .pacnew instead of overwriting
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Upgrades never overwrite existing modified configs, producing .pacnew files.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Use DIFF tools or pacdiff to review and merge .pacnew files.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not ignore accumulating .pacnew files as they contain critical new defaults.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: makepkg and AUR helpers must run as non-root user
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Arch Linux forbids makepkg or AUR helpers (yay/paru) from running as root.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Execute AUR builds under regular user privileges.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Never run sudo makepkg or sudo yay.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (unable to lock database|error: failed to init transaction \(unable to lock database\)|/var/lib/pacman/db.lck: File exists)
common_error_signatures.remediation: pgrep pacman >/dev/null && echo 'Pacman is running' || sudo rm -f /var/lib/pacman/db.lck
common_error_signatures.explanation: Pacman lock file exists from a background or interrupted pacman command.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (invalid or corrupted package \(PGP signature\)|error: .* signature from .* is unknown trust|key .* could not be looked up remotely)
common_error_signatures.explanation: The local Arch Linux keyring is out of date and cannot verify package signatures.

common_error_signatures.pattern: error: failed to commit transaction \(conflicting files\):\s*(.*) exists in filesystem
common_error_signatures.explanation: An untracked file exists on the filesystem that collides with the package being installed.

common_error_signatures.pattern: modprobe: FATAL: Module (.*) not found in directory /lib/modules
common_error_signatures.remediation: echo 'Kernel was updated. A system reboot is required to load new modules.' && uname -r
common_error_signatures.explanation: Kernel modules for the currently running kernel were removed during a live kernel package upgrade.

commands.clean_cache: sudo apk cache clean && sudo rm -rf /var/cache/apk/*

commands.open_port: sudo awall enable custom-rule && sudo awall activate
commands.close_port: sudo awall disable custom-rule && sudo awall activate
commands.deny_port: sudo awall disable custom-rule && sudo awall activate
commands.allow_source_port: sudo awall enable custom-rule && sudo awall activate

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Alpine uses OpenRC instead of systemd
quirks_and_gotchas.description: systemctl and journalctl do not exist on Alpine Linux.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Use rc-service <svc> <action>, rc-update add <svc> default, and logread.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Never suggest systemctl or journalctl on Alpine Linux.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Alpine uses musl libc instead of GNU glibc
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Precompiled binaries linked dynamically against glibc will fail to execute with 'not found'.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Install gcompat or libc6-compat (apk add gcompat libc6-compat).
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not attempt to run standard glibc binaries without compatibility layers.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Bash is not installed by default
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Alpine uses Busybox ash as the default /bin/sh shell.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Write standard POSIX sh scripts or install bash via apk add bash.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not rely on bash-specific syntax (bashisms) without ensuring bash is present.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (/lib/apk/db/lock: Resource temporarily unavailable|apk: could not open database: Permission denied)
common_error_signatures.explanation: APK lock is held by another running package process or was left behind.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (not found.*glibc|cannot open shared object file: ld-linux|No such file or directory.*ld-linux)
common_error_signatures.explanation: Binary compiled against GNU libc cannot run on musl libc without compatibility packages.

common_error_signatures.pattern: UNSATISFIABLE:\s*(.*)
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo apk update && sudo apk add --no-cache --upgrade {package}
common_error_signatures.explanation: Package dependency solver encountered unsatisfiable constraints in configured APK repositories.

common_error_signatures.pattern: service (.*) is crashed
common_error_signatures.explanation: OpenRC detected that the service daemon PID exited abnormally.

commands.fix_broken: sudo zypper clean -a && sudo zypper ref -f && sudo rpm --rebuilddb

commands.allow_source_port: sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule='rule family="ipv4" source address="{source_ip}" port port="{port}" protocol="{proto}" accept' && sudo firewall-cmd --reload

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Zypper requires --non-interactive for automated scripts
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Zypper prompts interactively on conflicts or license agreements by default.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not execute bare zypper in scripts.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Btrfs Snapper automatic snapshots can consume storage
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Automated pre/post snapshots on zypper transactions can exhaust free blocks on /.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Inspect snapshots with sudo snapper list and prune with snapper cleanup number.
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not delete snapshot subvolumes manually without using snapper.

quirks_and_gotchas.title: Zypper restricts repository vendor change by default
quirks_and_gotchas.description: Packages will not automatically upgrade to versions from different repository vendors.
quirks_and_gotchas.recommendation: Supply --allow-vendor-change when intentionally upgrading from external repos (e.g. Packman).
quirks_and_gotchas.do_not_do: Do not assume packages automatically switch repository sources.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (System management is locked by the application with pid ([0-9]+)|/var/run/zypp.pid: Resource temporarily unavailable)
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo systemctl stop packagekit; sudo kill -9 {match_2} 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /var/run/zypp.pid
common_error_signatures.explanation: PackageKit or another Zypper process is holding the system management lock.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (Valid metadata not found at specified URL|Download \(curl\) error for .* repository)
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo zypper clean -a && sudo zypper ref -f
common_error_signatures.explanation: Zypper repository metadata cache is corrupted or stale.

common_error_signatures.pattern: The following package update will NOT be installed because it requires a vendor change
common_error_signatures.explanation: Zypper prevented an automatic package vendor change without explicit authorization.

common_error_signatures.pattern: (No space left on device.*btrfs|BTRFS: error .* free space)
common_error_signatures.remediation: sudo snapper cleanup number && sudo btrfs balance start -dusage=5 /
common_error_signatures.explanation: Btrfs filesystem has exhausted free blocks due to accumulated Snapper snapshots.
